newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 11.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 44.33 points or 0.57 percent to 7,886.76, rebounding from a previous sharp loss.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index plumbed new 1-1/2 year lows, falling 24.72 points or 2.39 percent to 1,008.52. The market had fallen 2.32 percent on Wednesday.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.4934/44 a dollar at around 0102 GMT, weaker from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Thursday at 2.4905/15.
* Malaysia stocks may stage a weak rebound, with support for the key index at 960 points, below psychological level of 1,000 points.
* Philippines Central Bank said on Friday it would allow the peso to move in a wider range against the dollar. It did not say what the wider rate would be. Peso gyrations may affect the ringgit.
* Konsortium Perkapalan said it has received regulatory approval to negotiate buying a stake in Malaysian International Shipping Corp. Both stocks remain is suspension.
